title: SACRED VALLEY & RAINBOW MOUNTAIN
description: Discover the magic of the Sacred Valley of the Incas and the impressive Rainbow Mountain. This tour combines history, culture, and nature in a single unforgettable journey.
shortItinerary: Day 2: Sacred Valley - Chinchero - Moray - Maras
Day 3: Rainbow Mountain - Return to Cusco

itinerary.title: Cusco - Ollantaytambo - Pisac
itinerary.description: Hotel pickup and transfer to the Sacred Valley. We'll visit the ruins of Ollantaytambo and the bustling Pisac with its artisan market.

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley - Chinchero - Moray - Maras
itinerary.description: We'll explore the ceremonial centers of Chinchero, the agricultural terraces of Moray, and the ancestral salt mines of Maras.

itinerary.title: Rainbow Mountain - Return to Cusco
itinerary.description: Trek to the famous Vinicunca or Rainbow Mountain, with 360° panoramic views. Return to Cusco in the afternoon.

includes: Tourist transport for the entire tour
recommendations: Bring a sweater or jacket for cool afternoons
